pages.text: You know this trick all too well: summon a few water mines, block a few routes, and wait for some unlucky soul to bite - and you know it not only because you saw it used by the Gemstone Malignasaur.

pages.title: Malignasaur Bomb Focus
pages.text: 28 souls, 1.5 seconds of wind-up, 6 second cooldown. Lays 48-64 mines at once, each exploding for 2 + spell level x 0.25; a Abyss Staff adds one level.
